text:
Maya: Hey folks — thinking of two low-key options for Saturday: Secret Garden pop-up brunch (outdoor, small venue) or a late-night vinyl listening session at my place after 9pm. Who's up? :sun_with_face: :vinyl:
Kevin: Garden brunch sounds lovely. My plant allergies might complain but I can bring antihistamines 😅
Sasha: Vinyl night for me — I can bring that new pressing. @Maya what time is the brunch?
Maya: Brunch is 11:30. It's a tiny place so I need to RSVP by Friday. Link: https://tinyurl.com/gardenbrunch (menu looks good)
Priya: Vinyl please — I've got a deadline so brunch is risky for me. +1 for 9:30pm records & chai.
Alex: I can do either. If brunch wins I'll bring sourdough, if vinyl I'll bring portable speakers and snacks.
Kevin: If there's a poll, vote me for brunch unless the weather is trash. :cloud_rain:
Maya: Quick poll — reply with "brunch" or "vinyl" and I'll tally. I can also break ties since I need to RSVP.
Priya: vinyl
Alex: brunch
Sasha: vinyl
Kevin: brunch
ops-bot: Reminder — office plants watering shift this weekend: @Alex on Saturday, @Priya on Sunday :seedling:
Maya: Tally time — brunch: Alex, Kevin (2). Vinyl: Priya, Sasha (2). Since I need to RSVP and brunch requires a reservation, I'll take the tie-breaker and book brunch. I'll DM confirmations and the exact address. If you can't make brunch, vinyl night is on as a fallback at 9:30pm. See you either way! :confetti_ball:
